components.css: .ds-line { position: relative; height: 2.6rem; min-width: 14rem; font-family: var(--body); } .ds-line-rail { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0.75rem; height: 2px; background: var(--rule); } .ds-line-span { position: absolute; top: 0.75rem; height: 2px; background: var(--silver); transition: left 200ms var(--ease), width 200ms var(--ease); } .ds-line-tick { position: absolute; top: 0.5rem; width: 1px; height: 0.6rem; background: var(--rule); } .ds-line-tick-label { position: absolute; top: 1.05rem; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 0.625rem; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-line-end { position: absolute; top: 1.55rem; font-size: 0.625rem; color: var(--muted); } .ds-line-end-start { left: 0; } .ds-line-end-stop { right: 0; } .ds-station { position: absolute; top: calc(0.75rem + 1px); width: 0.8rem; height: 0.8rem; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transition: left 200ms var(--ease); } .ds-station-p50 { background: var(--night); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--silver); } .ds-station-p995 { width: 3px; height: 1.15rem; border-radius: 0; background: var(--window); transform: translate(-50%, -100%); } .ds-station-p995::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--window); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-station-p99 { background: var(--sodium); width: 0.95rem; height: 0.95rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--night), 0 0 0.75rem rgb(255 182 39 / 0.45); }

components.css: .ds-endpoints { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--body); color: var(--text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-endpoints thead th { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); text-align: left; padding: 0 0.75rem 0.6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-endpoints td, .ds-endpoints tbody th { padding: 0.95rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); text-align: left; font-weight: 400; } .ds-endpoints tbody tr { transition: background 150ms; } .ds-endpoints tbody tr:hover { background: var(--street); } .ds-num { text-align: right !important; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-p99 { color: var(--sodium); font-weight: 600; } .ds-ep-method { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--muted); } .ds-ep-note { display: block; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 0.2rem; } .ds-code { margin-right: 0.6rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--lamplit); } .ds-code-n { color: var(--muted); } .ds-code-4xx { color: var(--sodium); } .ds-code-5xx { color: var(--bad); }

narrative.overview:
The dashboard is a transit map read at night. A dark street ground, a cobalt band across the top like a station canopy, and one sodium lamp that marks whatever matters or can be pressed. Each endpoint is a line on a log-scale rail from 1 ms to 2 s, and its percentiles are stations along it: p50 a hollow silver ring, p99 a lit sodium stop, p99.5 a window-blue stem rising off the rail. The numbers are what the server measures about itself, so the surface stays quiet and lets them move.

It belongs to the same family as the author's portfolio world ("Night Transit": same night/cobalt/sodium/window/silver palette, Big Shoulders caps over Overpass) without copying it. What this build adds is the instrument: a single scrolling page of flat horizontal bands split by 1px rules, tabular numerals everywhere, and a signature latency line instead of KPI cards. Density is medium-high and calm; motion is limited to stations gliding on each 2 s poll, a pulsing live dot, and a skeleton shimmer, all removed under reduced motion.

The confirmed rejection is the admin template: no hero-metric-plus-card-grid, no rounded panels, no decorative charts.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only (`color-scheme: dark`), night ground with a cobalt top band.
One sodium accent for action and emphasis; window blue and silver for data.
Big Shoulders uppercase for headings and the big readouts; Overpass with tabular numerals for everything else.
Flat bands divided by 1px rules; no cards, no container backgrounds.
Square corners everywhere except the round stations and the status dot.
The latency line is the signature: log rail, SLO-bucket ticks, three percentile stations.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Sodium is the only colour that means "press this" or "look here". If a new element is clickable, focused or the headline number in its row, it is sodium; nothing else competes for that job.

rules.name: The Data Light Rule
rules.body: Window blue and silver mark measured values and the server's own process state. They never fill a button, link or focus state.

rules.name: The Caps Signage Rule
rules.body: Every Big Shoulders setting is uppercase. Thin (300) for the large readouts and full-state messages, heavy (600–700) for anything that names a thing (product, section, button).

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are tabular everywhere (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on `:root`). Units sit beside numbers in muted at 0.8em.

rules.name: The Only Light Glows Rule
rules.body: A blurred shadow exists only where sodium light is emitted. Neutral surfaces never get drop shadows.

dos: **Do** keep sodium (#ffb627) as the single action and emphasis colour: one button, the p99 station and column, focus, selection, live dot.
**Do** split content into full-width bands with 1px rule dividers and the fluid gutter (`clamp(1rem, 4vw, 3rem)`).
**Do** set every Big Shoulders heading in uppercase: thin 300 for big readouts, 600–700 for names.
**Do** keep numerals tabular and units muted at 0.8em.
**Do** use round shapes only for stations and status dots; everything else stays square.
**Do** ease movement with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` at 150–200ms, and drop all animation under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** label simulated latency and make cold start, offline, empty and loading states explicit.
donts: **Don't** build KPI cards, rounded panels, or a hero-metric-plus-card-grid layout.
**Don't** use window blue or silver for buttons, links, focus or selection.
**Don't** add drop shadows to neutral surfaces; only sodium elements glow.
**Don't** set Big Shoulders in sentence case or use it for body copy.
**Don't** round the corners of buttons, meters, tables or bands.
